scribd.com — Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete — https://www.scribd.com/document/359822446/CT-631-Design-Calculation-Sheet-Rev-01-pdf
(found by the search; not opened or cited)
Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: The panel listing in Insulated PUR PIR Sandwich Panel 100mm Cold Room Panels Roof Cladding from China Factory (E60) lists 100 mm weight 12.1 kg per square metre, consistent with the 14.0 kg per square metre row in Fire Proof Interior / Exterior PU/ Rock Wool Insulation Wall / Ceiling Sandwich Panel for Cold Room (E61), supporting the summed chamber mass budget (E66) of 1780 kg for produce plus crates plus Polyisocyanurate (PIR, rigid foam insulation) panels plus battery plus plates, about one small car in everyday scale, giving 18.2 kPa per pad in the pad pressure check (E68) on six 400 mm pads, well below the 150 kPa net allowable soil pressure used in Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), with adjustable feet and raised plinth as shown in the split layout sketch (E70).
Manager said about it: Total mass 1780 kilogram in the summed chamber mass budget (E66), about one small car, gives pressure 18.2 kilopascal in the pad pressure check (E68) below 150 kilopascal soil in Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), with interior 8.64 cubic metres in the interior volume estimate (E39) and conduction 203 watt in the conduction estimate (E41) and door loss 0.44 kilowatt-hour per day in the door infiltration estimate (E57) inside staged average 615 watt in the revised steady-load simulation (E28), holding 1000 kilogram in the total produce mass estimate (E49) as fifty crates in the crates for 1 tonne check (E77).
Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: Total with grown nine-module allowance is 1840 kg in the grown mass calc (E87), about one small car, giving 18.8 kPa per pad in the grown pad pressure calc (E89) on six 400 mm pads, well below the 150 kPa allowable in Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), so my prior 18.2 kPa check holds with margin.
Manager said about it: Grown total 1840 kilogram in the grown mass calc (E87) supersedes 1780 kilogram in the summed chamber mass budget (E66), giving 18.8 kilopascal in the grown pad pressure calc (E89) superseding 18.2 kilopascal in the pad pressure check (E68) and still below 150 kilopascal soil in Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), with nine-module footprint 17.6 square metres in the nine-module footprint calc (E84) from module size in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) split as 2 on roof plus 7 on ground in the grown split-array sketch (E85) with wind uplift like 673 kilogram in the uplift calc (E90) held by screw anchors.
Manager said about it: RECORD: Proposal version one stands with grown split array with battery bank with monoblock cooling with insulated box with racked crates with probe thermostat, numbers that stand are 1000 kg (E49) as 50 crates (E77) staged 12.5 per day (E78), yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day (E83) against load 13.2 kilowatt-hour per day (E58) margin 0.300 kilowatt-hour per day (E86), conduction 203 watt (E41) plus door 0.44 kilowatt-hour per day (E57) inside 615 watt (E28), grown mass 1840 kg (E87) giving 18.8 kilopascal (E89) below 150 kilopascal (E62) with 17.6 square metre nine-module split 2 plus 7 (E84, E85), still open only 43 degree pull-down bench test needing built hardware owed to test team.
Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: Chamber share on six 400 mm pads gives 19.8 kPa in the chamber structure soil pressure (E119) below 150 kPa soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), factor about eight, using interior 8.64 cubic metres from the interior volume estimate (E39) with envelope 25.4 square metres from the envelope area square metres (E40) giving conduction 203 W from the conduction watts at 43C ambient 5C room (E41), so the same envelope controls conduction.
Manager said about it: RECORD: Decided are grown split array with battery bank with monoblock cooling with insulated box with racked crates with probe control as version two; numbers that stand are 1000 kilogram (E49) as 50 crates (E77) staged 12.5 per day (E78), yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day (E83) against controlling 10.4 kilowatt-hour per day (E111) with door 0.170 kilowatt-hour per day (E110), conduction 203 Watt (E41) in 8.64 cubic metres (E39), complete 2210 kilogram (E118) giving 19.8 kilopascal (E119) below 150 kilopascal (E62) with 1390 kilogram hold against 673 kilogram uplift; still open are only field pull test and 43 degree pull-down bench test owed to test team.
Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: Chamber superstructure without foundations is 1930 kg in the chamber-only mass sum (E126), reusing produce plus crates plus racking plus panels plus door plus battery plus eutectic plus monoblock plus roof gantry shares from the complete superstructure mass sum (E118) but excluding the seven-module ground frame, and with six 400 mm by 400 mm pads plus their own self-weight it gives 23.2 kPa in the chamber-only pad pressure (E127), still below 150 kPa soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), about one person standing so everyday scale holds, which supersedes 19.8 kPa from the chamber structure soil pressure (E119) as the chamber-only controlling value while the ground frame goes to its own footings.
Manager said about it: Complete 2210 kilogram from the complete superstructure mass sum (E118) as produce plus crates plus racking plus panels plus door plus battery plus eutectic plus monoblock plus frames plus modules plus wiring separates to chamber 1930 kilogram from the chamber-only mass sum (E126) giving 23.2 kilopascal from the chamber-only pad pressure (E127) and 28.5 kilopascal with foundations, which supersedes 19.8 kilopascal from the chamber structure pressure (E119) as the controlling chamber value, still below 150 kilopascal soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet (E62), about one person standing so everyday scale holds, with 673 kilogram uplift from the wind uplift equivalent (E90) on 17.6 square metres from the nine-module footprint (E84) held by 1390 kilogram from eight anchors in the anchor hold calculation (E123), with crate layout from the dimensioned crate layout sketch (E124).
Manager said about it: RECORD: Decided are grown split array with battery bank with monoblock cooling with insulated box with racked crates with probe control as version three superseding version two chamber pressure; numbers that stand are 1000 kilogram (E49) as 50 crates (E77) staged 12.5 per day (E78), yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day (E83) against controlling 10.4 kilowatt-hour per day (E111) from thermal 13.5 (E109) with door 0.169 (E110) by COP 1.40, chamber 1930 kilogram (E126) giving 23.2 kilopascal (E127) below 150 kilopascal (E62) with complete 2210 kilogram (E118) and 1390 kilogram hold against 673 kilogram uplift, 17.6 square metre split 2 plus 7 (E84); still open are member votes on version three and field pull plus 43 degree bench tests owed to test team.
Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: Reusing the complete superstructure mass sum (E118) at 2210 kg naming produce plus crates plus racking plus panels plus door plus battery plus eutectic plus monoblock plus roof gantry plus ground frame plus wiring, separated to the chamber-only mass sum (E126) at 1930 kg excluding the seven-module ground frame, giving the chamber-only pad pressure (E127) at 23.2 kPa and 28.5 kPa with foundation self-weight, which supersedes 19.8 kPa and stays below 150 kPa soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet source (E62), about one person standing at 20 to 30 kPa so everyday scale holds.
Manager said about it: Complete 2210 kilogram from the complete superstructure mass sum (E118) as produce plus crates plus racking plus panels plus door plus battery plus eutectic plus monoblock plus frames plus wiring separates to chamber 1930 kilogram from the chamber-only mass sum (E126) giving 23.2 kilopascal from the chamber-only pad pressure (E127) and 28.5 kilopascal with foundations, which supersedes 19.8 kilopascal from the chamber structure pressure (E119), still below 150 kilopascal soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet (E62), about one person standing so everyday scale holds.
Manager said about it: RECORD: Decided are grown split array with battery bank with monoblock cooling with insulated box with racked crates with probe control as version three superseding version two chamber pressure; numbers that stand are 1000 kilogram (E49) as 50 crates (E77) staged 12.5 per day (E78), yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day (E83) against controlling 10.4 kilowatt-hour per day (E111) from thermal 13.5 (E109) with door 0.169 (E110) by COP 1.40, chamber 1930 kilogram (E126) giving 23.2 kilopascal (E127) below 150 kilopascal (E62) with complete 2210 kilogram (E118) and 1390 kilogram hold against 673 kilogram uplift, 17.6 square metre split 2 plus 7 (E84); still open are only field uniformity pull test and 43 degree pull-down bench test owed to test team, which need built hardware and do not block concept; Solar Energy Systems Engineer, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Enclosure and Structural Designer and Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist all voted ready on version three and their reasons are answered above.
